package rulefixtures

import "gorm.io/gorm"

// scenario for password_stored_as_plaintext: struct fields named `Password`, `Passwd`, or `Pwd` stored as `string` in database model structs without evidence of hashing
// fixture polarity: positive; family: security; severity: error.
type Rule728PositiveUser struct {
	gorm.Model
	Email    string
	Password string
}

func scenario728Positive(db *gorm.DB, email, password string) error {
	user := Rule728PositiveUser{
		Email:    email,
		Password: password,
	}
	return db.Create(&user).Error
}
